An iterator class over phylogenetic forest nodes

Source: R/RcppExports.R
PhylogeneticForestNodeTour.Rd

Iterators over phylogenetic forest nodes.

Details

This class represents iterators over phylogenetic forest nodes. The objects of this class are built by get_node_tour() and provide the following methods and properties:

  • node is an object of the class SampleForestNode and represents the node pointed by the iterator.

  • label represents the label of the of the node pointed by the iterator. The presence of this field depends on the type of the get_node_tour()'s parameters used to create the tour object (OPTIONAL).

  • genome is an object of the class GenomeMutations that represent the genome of the node pointed by the iterator (OPTIONAL).

  • step() moves the iterator to the next node in the tour.

  • done is a Boolean flag that is set to TRUE only when the tour ended.

See also

get_node_tour(), PhylogeneticForestNode, PhylogeneticForestNodeTour, vignette("node_tour")
